name: Toy items API
problem: The production line needs a real service to create, build, launch and operate before venture 1. The toy is an in-memory Express items API that already carries wi-1..wi-12 (35/35 tests). Phase 3 must take it from a signed Brief to a running local URL through /create-project -> /build-spec -> /build-implement -> /launch -> /deploy with exactly two human actions, and prove that a regressed candidate rolls back on its own.
users: The plant itself: the workflows under test, and the founder auditing them from the gate queue and the ledger.

success_metrics.metric: healthy launches promoted to prod through /launch + /deploy
seeded-regression drills that auto-roll back without a human
human actions from Brief to live URL

kill_criteria: a launch needs a third human action to reach prod
the Create + Launch stretch (create-project, launch, deploy) costs more than $2 per launch after the first
constraints: deploy target is a local port on 127.0.0.1; no cloud
every existing route and test keeps passing
new work is additive and low-risk so the Spec Gate is not needed on this stretch
initial_scope: GET /items accepts an optional ?offset=N (canonical non-negative decimal integer) that skips the first N items after the ?sort stage and before the ?limit cap; any other value returns 400 { "error": "invalid offset" }; an offset past the end returns []; all existing behavior is unchanged
